data_policy: only historical Car2 development cases; inherited P1/geometry/time settings not transferred to T08/T10
event_policy: receive-ordered JSONL.gz, original physical record_index and arrival_order_index separate; all records retain source SHA/receive ns and raw-message SHA; motion/UWB topics retain full fields
time_policy: integer epoch ns and centered relative seconds; no clock correction or receive-header calibration
new_model_field_execution: pending A exact FGO commit/protocol; no substitute optimizer
mandatory_review: F2/F3 keyframe prediction, optimizer initialization, startup and fallback must expose any Odom heading dependency
retained marginal prior must include position/yaw/bias cross-information and affine residual
incident factors eliminated once, retained factors not counted twice
each dependency arrived by original one-second publication cutoff; no published-history rewrite
all coverage/failure/fallback intervals plus common-valid intervals, never favorable-only selection
calibration: gyro axes/noise/clock/bias parameters not inferred from endpoint or unaccepted video
historical_endpoint_policy: frozen manual stopping window may be reported as uncertain development endpoint diagnostic; never tune parameters with it
